zeref.want: Bots look at repo skills. Guideboard next to repo skills explains how to use them so agents succeed. Skill Tree stores every board skill by genre. Agents forget/adapt/equip skills on demand like Iron Man suits. Grok-bot instructions stay stagnant. Skill switch is how real progress happens.

already_on_campus.skillspector: scan before a skill can change an agent
already_on_campus.skill-rack: equip scanned skills onto a pal. Blocked unless Spector SAFE/CAUTION
already_on_campus.efficiency-guide: Brain Bridge router, not a skill catalog

success_guide: 1. Open Skill Tree. Filter by genre of the current job.
2. Read the skill howTo. If sourceUrl is a repo, read README before claiming you have it.
3. Walk it through Spector Gate. SAFE or CAUTION only.
4. Equip on Skill Rack. One primary skill per job. Forget the last job's skill first.
5. Do the task. Report evidence. Register is not proof.
6. Forget when the job changes. Grok standing orders stay put.
first_slice: read-only Skill Tree JSON + Guide Board copy on Skill Rack/Altar inspector. No new mesh. No auto-equip.
